title: Engine catalog
description: Data about one speech engine: where its source is, the commit it was tested at and the model files it needs.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

engine.description: Engine name; the file is gvoice/engines/<engine>.json.

commit.description: Engine commit the catalog was measured with.

id.description: Model id (lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens), as in the machine profiles and printModels.

file.description: File name inside the models folder (a plain name, never a path).

bytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

use.description: What the model is for: design a voice, produce lines with a fixed voice, or encode and decode audio.

sampling.description: Sampling values of the checkpoint: the last layer of the resolution.
